paper_title: EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese   Essay Writing
caption: Dataset Statistics. Note that Open denotes Open-Ended sets, Cons. refers to Constrained sets.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the sample counts for different essay genres within a dataset, comparing open-ended (Open) and constrained (Cons.) writing tasks. The horizontal axis displays four distinct essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—arranged in a fixed, non-numeric order. The vertical axis represents the sample count, scaled linearly from 0 to 120 in increments of 20, with values labeled at each interval. Each genre has two adjacent bars: a light blue bar representing the open-ended set and a light pink bar representing the constrained set, as indicated by the legend. The height of each bar corresponds to the number of samples in that category, with specific values labeled above each bar. For the Argumentative genre, the open-ended count is 79 and the constrained count is 122. For Narrative, the counts are 80 and 87, respectively. In the Descriptive genre, the counts are 68 and 100. For Expository, the counts are 62 and 130. The bars are grouped by genre, with the open-ended bar positioned to the left of the constrained bar in each group. The chart shows that for each genre, the constrained set has a higher sample count than the open-ended set.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart, titled "Dataset Statistics" and associated with the paper "EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese Essay Writing," displays the sample counts for four different essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—across two distinct types of writing tasks: Open-ended (labeled "Open") and constrained (labeled "Cons."). The vertical y-axis represents the "Sample Count," ranging from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. The horizontal x-axis lists the four genres. For each genre, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for the Open set and a light pink bar for the Cons. set. The specific sample counts are as follows: for Argumentative, 79 (Open) and 122 (Cons.); for Narrative, 80 (Open) and 87 (Cons.); for Descriptive, 68 (Open) and 100 (Cons.); and for Expository, 62 (Open) and 130 (Cons.). The chart clearly illustrates that for all four genres, the constrained set has a higher sample count than the open-ended set. The tallest bar is the "Cons." bar for Expository, with a count of 130, while the shortest is the "Open" bar for Expository, with a count of 62.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Stichprobengrößen (Sample Count) für vier verschiedene Essay-Genres – Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive und Expository – unter zwei verschiedenen Bedingungen: Open (offene Aufgabenstellung) und Cons. (eingeschränkte Aufgabenstellung), wobei die Werte jeweils die Anzahl der Proben in den entsprechenden Kategorien darstellen. Die horizontale Achse stellt die vier Genres dar, die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge angeordnet sind, während die vertikale Achse die Sample Count von 0 bis 130 in Schritten von 20 anzeigt. Jedes Genre verfügt über zwei nebeneinander angeordnete Balken: ein hellblauer Balken für die Open-Kategorie und ein rosa Balken für die Cons.-Kategorie, wie in der Legende oben rechts angegeben. Die Balkenhöhen variieren je nach Genre und Bedingung: für Argumentative sind die Werte 79 (Open) und 122 (Cons.), für Narrative 80 (Open) und 87 (Cons.), für Descriptive 68 (Open) und 100 (Cons.), und für Expository 62 (Open) und 130 (Cons.). Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern folgen der alphabetischen Reihenfolge der Genres, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Linien. Die genauen Werte für jede Kombination von Genre und Bedingung sind direkt über den jeweiligen Balken als numerische Beschriftungen angegeben.
